gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Neon glows with tall, stamped-metal lowercase and a hairline-slim line that never wavers. Noto Sans Rejang sits underneath in a sans-serif with wide, porthole-like counters, which gives the heading plenty of room to shine against it.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic has a big x-height and curves that never quite close up. Over a long passage it reads in a plain sans manner, modern and unfussy, while Neon above it keeps its round, rim-and-stem uniform glow.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Noto Sans Samaritan is hefty and approachable, with curves full of daylight. Run down a long stretch, its weighty lowercase forms a dense, friendly stripe, and Neon's cable-steady strokes stay up top as the vibrant counterpoint.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Technical-pen steadiness runs through every Neon letter, tall and stamped like metal type with generous spacing. And Noto Sans Saurashtra reads cleanly over a longer stretch, its capitals barely rising above the lowercase and its counters staying open to the outside.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-sc: Noto Sans SC reads modern and quiet, its chalky curves stopping short of closing. Neon is the one to make a glowing statement with its hum-smooth tall letters, while the body font simply carries the text.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Noto Sans Sharada brings bulky lowercase proportions and open c forms that never close into rings. And across a longer passage it stays clean and steady, a good foil for Neon's ruler-and-compass line.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Noto Sans Siddham is approachable and a bit generous in its text line. Over a longer passage that large central band and the s with its far-hanging ends make a relaxed plain sans read, while Neon's stencil-brush line glows above.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Glowing, tall and stamped, Neon is the one built to catch the eye with its string-steady strokes. Noto Sans Sinhala does the quieter job, laying a thick dark stripe of lowercase through each line with curve endings kept well apart.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Neon glows with tall, stamped-metal lowercase and bowls that never swell. Noto Sans Soyombo follows with a sizable x-height and wide, unclosed curves, a sans that keeps the page easy on the screen.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Noto Sans Sundanese is clean and neutral, with open-mouthed e crossbars and capitals that barely rise above the lowercase. Over a longer stretch it stays quietly smooth.
